topic.title: Finalizing Your Review
topic.shortdesc: Use the Finalize my review action to tell task owners that you finished reviewing the task assigned to you. This action does not close or delete the review task.

body.p: As a reviewer, use Finalize my review when you have finished reviewing all files in a task and want to notify the task owners. This action changes your individual review status to Finalized. It is available in the review task header if your review is not already finalized.
When you click Finalize my review, adds a predefined message to the task to indicate that you completed your review. You can also add an optional message with more details.

ul.li: Finalizing your review is a reviewer-level action. It does not change the task state, lock the task, or remove the task. To stop editing for all reviewers, a task owner must close the review task. To permanently remove a task, an owner must delete the review task.
You can see tasks that you finalized on the My Review Tasks page. Open the Assigned To Me tab and click Show finalized if those tasks are hidden.

Your Finalized status remains visible after the task leaves the In review state. If you make more changes in the task after finalizing, your status changes back to In progress. The task owner can also reset individual review statuses by reopening a closed task or using Request re-review. In those cases, use Finalize my review again after you finish the new review cycle.
